Mumbai)"}],"comment":"The title block specifies material as \"M.S.\" (mild steel) while note N1 requires \"En-8(D)\" medium-carbon steel, which is a direct contradiction. This conflict will cause procurement and manufacturing errors; the designer must align the title-block material field with the note.","recommended_correction":"Change the title-block material to \"En-8(D)\" or remove the conflicting specification from note N1 so both agree."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"4) $ FLASH HARD CHROME PLATING 15 TO 20 MICRONS, HARDNESS 850 TO 1000 HV."}],"comment":"Note N4 calls out 15–20 microns of hard chrome plating, but no shaft diameter dimensions on the drawing carry an allowance for this added thickness. Without accounting for the plating build-up, mating fits will be too tight after coating; the designer must reduce the pre-plate machined diameters by the plating thickness or explicitly state that dimensions apply after plating.","recommended_correction":"Add plating-thickness allowances to the relevant shaft diameter dimensions or add a note clarifying that all functional dimensions are after plating."}]}
